caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic jug or pitcher, rendered in a combination of pencil and possibly light watercolor or colored pencil. The jug has a bulbous body, a narrow neck, a pronounced pouring spout, and a high, angular handle that extends from the top of the neck to the upper shoulder of the vessel. The body of the jug displays reflective highlights and soft shading, giving it a silvery-gray color and indicating a polished metal surface. The neck and base of the jug feature subtle decorative bands, with the base displaying some faint greenish and bluish tints, suggesting patina or intricate metalwork. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects depicted. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature, some numbers, and a date: "1-7-1936."
title: Silver Pitcher
